primitives.name: Source Quality Ledger
primitives.verbatim_quote: Source Quality Ledger: every sports signal gets source type, timestamp, confidence, conflict state, and reviewer status.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'signal identifier (dimensionless)', 'T_s': 'source type (categorical)', 't': 'timestamp (seconds since epoch)', 'C': 'confidence score (0–1)', 'F': 'conflict state (boolean)', 'R': 'reviewer status (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Signals are independently sourced; each signal has a unique identifier; confidence is calibrated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C < 0.5 or F = true, signal enters quarantine.

layer2.mapping: Each signal maps to a node in a directed acyclic graph where edges represent temporal and causal relationships; reviewer status acts as a gatekeeper for edge validity.
layer2.telemetry: Signal freshness badge, confidence decay rate, conflict resolution time

primitives.name: No-Bet Intelligence
primitives.verbatim_quote: No-Bet Intelligence: "No Bet" becomes a high-value decision with reasons, uncertainty drivers, and education modules.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N': 'no-bet decision (boolean)', 'U': 'uncertainty driver magnitude (0–1)', 'R': 'reason taxonomy index (categorical)', 'E': 'education module ID (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: Uncertainty drives decision; reasons are exhaustive and mutually exclusive; education modules are pre-indexed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When U > threshold, N = true; otherwise N = false.

layer2.mapping: Derived from source quality ledger and market radar; represents a probabilistic rejection of action conditioned on signal ambiguity.
layer2.telemetry: No-bet frequency, average uncertainty driver, reason distribution

primitives.name: Market Radar
primitives.verbatim_quote: Market Radar: line movement, injury/news volatility, sharp/public divergence, and confidence decay shown as live but review-gated signals.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'line movement (USD)', 'V': 'volatility index (0–1)', 'D': 'divergence measure (0–1)', 'C_d': 'confidence decay (0–1 per hour)'}
primitives.assumptions: Line movement is a proxy for market sentiment; divergence indicates information asymmetry; decay is exponential.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D > threshold or V > threshold, signal is gated.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a vector field over time where each point represents a market state; divergence and volatility act as gradient components.
layer2.telemetry: Live signal latency, divergence count, decay rate per signal
